biotools.summary: OLAgen is an open-source tool that automates the development of oligonucleotide ligation assays (OLAs) and their coupled PCR assays, facilitating the detection of single-nucleotide variants and polymorphisms. The software streamlines probe design and screening, and successfully produces assays for various targets, demonstrating high sensitivity and specificity.
